zara (DevEx): Heads-up: found a confusing edge-case in the nextjs-starter-langchain sample. When the sample uses the proxy pattern (/api/proxy) to hide RW_KEY and we enable SDK retries + LangChain agent arms, a transient auth failure causes either a full SSE hang or duplicated paragraphs in the UI. Repro attached.

mina (Eng): Can you paste the minimal repro and logs? Is this happening with embeddings+RAG + streaming generation or just generation?

zara (DevEx): It's a RAG flow: embeddings (sync) -> retriever -> streaming generate. Sequence: 401 on initial generate, SDK retry kicks in and we see either: 1) no further SSE events (client stuck), or 2) UI shows two identical paragraphs (duplicate). Logs: ```
[2025-09-21T09:12:03Z] proxy /api/proxy -> fetch /v1/generate 401 {"message":"invalid api key"}
[2025-09-21T09:12:03Z] sdk.retry: auth -> attempting refresh
[2025-09-21T09:12:07Z] proxy /api/proxy -> fetch /v1/generate 200 (stream start)
[2025-09-21T09:12:07Z] sse: data chunk 1
[2025-09-21T09:12:07Z] sse: data chunk 2
...
```
But sometimes the frontend never receives chunk events after the retry. Other times it receives a second full stream and concatenates.

phil (DX): Sample app snippet (serverless proxy): ```js
// pages/api/proxy.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retry: { maxRetries: 2 } })
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const stream = await client.generateStream({ model: 'redwood/gpt-lite', prompt: req.body.prompt })
  stream.on('data', chunk => res.write(`data: ${chunk}\n\n`))
  stream.on('end', () => res.end())
}
```
Note: frontend opens EventSource('/api/proxy') and appends incoming SSE events to the conversation.

dave (SDK): This smells like two distinct issues: 1) retry wrapper replaying streaming requests without preserving/reattaching event handlers (causes hang or double stream), and 2) proxy + serverless buffering causing partial chunks to be forwarded then replayed. We assumed streaming paths are identity-safe; that's wrong.

mina (Eng): I reproduced locally: if the proxy starts piping chunks before the SDK completes the retry handshake, the first partial payload stays in the response buffer and then the retried stream starts, leading to duplicates. If the retry wrapper creates a new stream instance but response handlers weren't torn down correctly, frontend may wait forever if the original stream terminal event was swallowed.

zara (DevEx): Workarounds I tested that help: - set retry.maxRetries=0 for the proxy route (fast and effective) - add an idempotencyKey on generate requests (server dedupe) - in the frontend, discard partial stream buffer when a new stream starts (simple but surprising for users).

phil (DX): For onboarding, we should add a clear note in the starter README: "If you use a server proxy for streaming routes, set retry.maxRetries=0 or upgrade to SDK v0.11.3+ which fixes stream-replay behavior." Also add a short sample showing idempotencyKey usage with UUID per user session.

ci-bot: Buildkite: #5921 for branch nextjs-starter-proxy-fix queued :gear:

dave (SDK): Plan: 1) Quick fix in SDK: detect stream-producing endpoints and make retryer either no-op for auth-related failures or replay in a way that preserves the same stream instance and reattaches handlers. 2) Add idempotency header support (Idempotency-Key) for generate and eval endpoints. 3) Publish canary v0.11.3-canary-stream and bump starter. I'll open PRs today.

mina (Eng): I'll add an integration test in the example harness that simulates 401 then 200 and asserts no duplicated paragraphs and that SSE closes properly on end.

dave (SDK): One important note: we should avoid a blanket disable of retries for streaming because some infra errors are transient and users expect resilience. So we'll special-case auth (401/403) to surface to the app (no retry), while keeping other transient statuses retryable.

zara (DevEx): Sounds good. For now I'll update the starter README with the workaround and a one-liner: `retry: { maxRetries: 0 }` for streaming proxy routes, and include a tiny UI dedupe filter as a failsafe. I'll also add a troubleshooting section in the quickstart checklist.

phil (DX): I'll add a short guide showing how to wire idempotencyKey into LangChain's call context so template users get the pattern out-of-the-box.

dave (SDK): PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1987 (stream-retry fix + idempotency). Will post canary preview and changelog after CI.

zara (DevEx): Thanks all. Leaving this thread pinned until the canary is promoted and the example is bumped. If anyone hits this and needs a quick fix ping me or drop the canary URL here. :rocket:
